observation: V6.2 was not yet in main but was a clean descendant and could be fast-forward integrated; the only failed checks were pytest invocation-contract errors.
decision: Integrate V6.2, preserve its negative terminal, create the V6.3 branch from synchronized main, and register the resolved engineering issue without adding broad regression tests.

observation: Occupancy uncertainty, evidence, continuous queries, set/point attention, CVaR and conformal risk control all have strong primary-source precedent, while V6.2 artifacts prove prototype transfer is insufficient.
decision: Claim only the combined native-surface-tail-admission compiler, freeze case-level rather than voxel-level calibration, and materialize full native tensors before any quality result.

observation: The official frozen current-state forward materialized all 76 D/L native targets in 3.50 GB and stayed far below the single-3090 ceiling.
decision: Accept P2, keep C/H/T deferred, and use the four legal legacy native sidecars for the one-shot pointwise root-cause diagnostic.

observation: True native features left the four unsafe accepted legacy cases unchanged, with zero hard violations but insufficient coverage, R10, actor gain, UNKNOWN and worst-conflict gates.
decision: Treat prototype transfer as an aggravating factor rather than the root cause, close pointwise recovery, and proceed with the preregistered surface topology and patch-tail corpus.

observation: Probe r1 stopped before surface extraction because unequal target-grid axis arrays were stacked despite NumPy's same-shape contract.
decision: Keep r1 immutable, return the axes independently, preserve out-of-native-range points through explicit validity, and rerun the identical frozen probe as revision 2.

observation: Probe r2 stopped at entry because the launcher pre-created the immutable run leaf that the runner must create itself.
decision: Preserve the empty r2 run, remove only leaf pre-creation, and run the unchanged probe as revision 3.

observation: Probe r3 completed 152226 surface points but symmetric tiny components produced zero normals at discrete medial-axis points.
decision: Preserve all tiny proposals and use target-sensor viewpoint only to resolve zero face-sum plus zero centroid directions; do not filter geometry or relax the unit-normal gate.

observation: R4 passed geometry, but a P1-to-payload audit caught absent frozen features and a ray-hit-order semantic mismatch before formal materialization.
decision: Withhold full P3 promotion, complete only the preregistered fields using exact EDT and deterministic relative/order transforms, then run one final probe before the 72-unit formal.

observation: R5 validated aggregate fields, while P4 dropout design exposed that temporal counts cannot reconstruct a contiguous held-out method sweep.
decision: Keep this under V63-F06, add per-sweep state/contradiction matrices and one explicit required-field check, then prohibit further probes after r6.

observation: R6 completed 152226 points with per-sweep evidence, all required frozen fields, unit normals, bounded patches and all negative contracts.
decision: Accept the P3 probe gate, prohibit further probes, and materialize all 72 development targets with two workers.

observation: The first synthetic FP16 interface hit PyTorch's explicit autocast prohibition on probability-form BCE; the logit-form recovery completed finite forward/backward.
decision: Use BCE-with-logits for hidden-FREE and authority training while preserving sigmoid inference; keep real P4 execution locked until P3 formal passes.

observation: Packed proposal-token selection initially used a NumPy-only flatnonzero name in the PyTorch path; the official nonzero interface passed the two-proposal gradient check.
decision: Keep one token per proposal while packing tiny proposals for throughput, and keep all real P5 execution locked behind P3 and P4.

observation: Every one of the first 40 completed P3 units contained a surface larger than 8192 points, while H-P4-001 tested only the first chunk and generated a separate proposal token per chunk.
decision: Withdraw H-P4-001 without a run and preregister H-P4-002 so point graphs remain microbatched but all patch tokens of each selected proposal share one global attention context and proposal token.

observation: Chunk-local labels, structural masks, authority channels and hidden-FREE CVaR would drift or leak whenever one proposal crossed a point microbatch.
decision: Bind labels and one semantic selector to the complete proposal, recompute evidence-derived authority after masking, run proposal attention on the complete patch set, and join all selection hidden-FREE values before exact proposal CVaR; retain the disclosed stochastic training surrogate.

observation: Ranking pairs were still formed only from proposals co-occurring in a packed point chunk, so chunking changed nearest-size matching and could reuse a safe proposal.
decision: Match safe and unsafe proposals once over complete unit metadata, then evaluate the differentiable proposal attention/risk head over the complete current patch-token cache once per unit; do not add a stale cross-batch queue.

observation: Surface-wide 6-neighbor edges crossed frozen patch boundaries only when those patches happened to share an 8192-point chunk, making the local encoder packing-dependent.
decision: Bind both deterministic local aggregation blocks to complete frozen patches and reserve cross-patch interaction for complete-proposal patch attention; do not add random subgraph sampling or halo hyperparameters.

observation: A focused synthetic audit returned identical full/split patch-local directed-edge counts (4/4), and proposals placed in different chunks still produced the frozen safe/unsafe unit ranking pair [(0,1)].
decision: Keep the patch-local graph and complete-unit ranking implementations unchanged; do not add a broader smoke or regression matrix.

observation: Selection reconstructed complete proposal risks but passed all 24 selection units to one nearest-size matcher, allowing safe and unsafe proposals from different scene/frame cases to pair even though training matching was unit-local.
decision: Group selection matching by complete scene/frame unit and average only nonempty unit losses; keep margin, weight, cohort and gates unchanged.

observation: The capacity flag named cvar_gradient_nonzero inspected the hidden-FREE head total gradient, which could be nonzero from BCE even if the proposal-CVaR graph were disconnected.
decision: Measure a direct VJP from proposal_cvar.mean() to the state, hidden-FREE and authority heads; keep the existing gate and pass threshold unchanged.

observation: The formal point arrays encode method, target and contradiction correctly, but the registry/summary field hidden_free_count was computed as all target-FREE points rather than the method-UNKNOWN non-contradictory subset.
decision: Keep the long-running formal immutable, recompute correct descriptive counts once from its point arrays at terminal, fix future materialization, and prohibit downstream use of the mislabeled registry count.

observation: The 72-unit Tier-D formal completed 86360 surfaces, 111282 patches and 11583001 points in 47568.466 seconds with bounded patches, unit normals, complete fields and all negative contracts; the terminal point-array erratum count is 688837 hidden-FREE.
decision: Support H-P3-001, preserve the immutable v1 summary with its documented descriptive-statistic erratum, and unlock only the preregistered H-P4-002 capacity probe.

observation: H-P4-002 r1 used only 0.196070 GiB and passed finite loss, direct CVaR, proposal-token, hard-projection and checkpoint subcontracts, but total FP16 gradients were nonfinite and repeated/reloaded CUDA attention differed by 9.059906e-6 from exact zero.
decision: Preserve r1 and run one bounded recovery with AMP initial scale 1024 plus deterministic math SDPA; keep every scientific and resource contract unchanged.

observation: R2 stopped at the first CUDA math-attention operation because deterministic cuBLAS requires CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG before process startup; it reached no optimizer step, summary or quality read.
decision: Preserve the empty r2 leaf and bind :4096:8 in both launcher and pre-torch-import runner for r3, the first executable attempt of the same bounded recovery; keep AMP, SDPA, model, data, losses and gates unchanged.
